metadata.title: Stock Market Today: Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq rise after latest wholesale inflation data and as tech stocks rebound ahead of SpaceX IPO; U.S. and Iran exchange strikes for second day; Oracle shares slide - MarketWatch

content.text:
LIVE
Stock Market Today: Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq rise after latest wholesale inflation data and as tech stocks rebound ahead of SpaceX IPO; U.S. and Iran exchange strikes for second day; Oracle shares slide
The U.S. stock market was up Thursday, as investors assessed fresh data showing wholesale inflation in May rose more than expected. SpaceX is expected to make its market debut on Friday, after it prices the largest IPO ever.
Last Updated:
June 11, 2026 at 10:47 AM ET
Thursday's top reads
Wholesale inflation surges again and keeps the pressure on businesses and the U.S. economy
The big question facing SpaceX investors: What are you really buying?
Micron, Intel drag the tech sector into a new bearish phase. Will the correction last this time?
Oracle’s stock slides after earnings, as the steep price of AI spooks investors
